preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in S)
preconditions.description: The input string S consists only of characters '0' and '1'.
The length of S is strictly between 1 and 10^5.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for i in range(len(S)) for j in range(i + 1, len(S) + 1) if S[i:j].count('1') > S[i:j].count('0'))
postconditions.description: The function returns the count of all substrings of S where the number of '1's is strictly greater than the number of '0's.
